title: Vault Royale
tagline: Vault Royale is a battleground of AI-powered DeFi strategies.
description:
Vault Royale
Where Normies meet DeFi Pros. And where Pros get paid.

If you've ever tried copying top wallets on Debank, you know the thrill of following smart money.
Vault Royale makes that experience scalable and interactive.

It’s a platform where DeFi strategists create AI Agents that manage real user deposits across DeFi.

As a user, all you need to do is deposit — your chosen Agent takes care of the rest.

1. Who is it for?

- Users: Anyone looking to earn yield across multiple chains, without lifting a finger.
Think of it as a dynamic, multi-chain yield aggregator — but powered by battle-tested AI Agents built by humans.

- Vault Creators: DeFi strategists who design and prompt AI Agents to execute yield strategies.
They earn fees from the yield generated and compete to attract users by optimizing performance and updating strategies in real time.

What makes Vault Royale different?

1. A more dynamic and decentralized yield aggregator
Morpho relies on centralized "risk experts." Beefy runs fixed smart contract strategies.
Vault Royale goes further:
Each AI Agent adapts to market conditions, continuously optimizing strategy execution.
Every action is logged in the Vault Console, so users can watch decisions play out — before deciding where to deposit.

2. Not just vaults — a gamified arena of strategy battles
APYs are ever-changing. That’s why Vault Creators must continuously improve their Agents.
They fight for deposits, outmaneuvering others with better strategies.
It’s a game of yield, where AI and human skill form a team — and compete for capital.

3. No vault spam — only community-backed strategies get deployed
Too many vaults dilute liquidity and overwhelm users.
We added a Temperature Check stage — a community vote before any vault goes live.
Only vetted, high-potential strategies make it through.

In short: Vault Royale is
🧠 AI-powered vaults created by real DeFi strategists
💰 Yield for users, fees for the best creators
⚔️ A decentralized battlefield of strategy and performance
how_its_made:
Vault Royale is built with three core components: the Client (UI), the AI Agent (server), and the Vault Contracts.

Client: Built with lightweight React for speed and clarity. It lets users browse live AI-powered vaults and view real-time strategy logs.

AI Agent (Server): Each vault creator writes a natural language prompt. The AI Agent uses that prompt, external APIs, and market data (including smart money signals) to choose and optimize DeFi strategies. It runs server-side with automated strategy selection logic.

Smart Contracts: Each vault is deployed as an on-chain contract. We launched across multiple chains including Celo, Polygon, Rootstock, Flow, and Zircuit mainnet.

We integrated Nodit Webhook APIs to notify the system and users whenever an AI Agent updates its vault strategy. Keeping the battle dynamic and transparent.

PLUS The entire vault system is designed to be modular and chain-agnostic, so it can easily onboard new chains and yield protocols.
